'''N'Vaari''' was the [[Provincial Governor/Legends|Provincial Governor]] of [[Le Yer]] until [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] at the order of [[A'jidre Skrigatov]], who coveted his position. Five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, Skrigatov sought to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] N'Vaari's granddaughter, [[Brinaloy N'Vaari|Brinaloy]].
